revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.2% and FY2024 4.5%; modest housing-market recovery, then fading toward long-run growth. Analyst judgment.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2025 actual margin 20,890/164,683 = 12.7% (FY2023 14.2%, FY2024 13.5%); no recovery assumed.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06); ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16); unlevered beta 1.318 (Damodaran Retail Building Supply, cash-corrected) relevered at industry D/E 0.233 with 24% tax = 1.56; Ke 11.8%; pre-tax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran), after-tax 4.0%; weights 81.1%/18.9% (Damodaran industry; no share price available for HD market cap). WACC ~10.4%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate; mature retailer.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 55,772 (LT debt 46,341 + current 4,967 + commercial paper 4,464) - cash 1,389; 10-K 0001628280-26-019436; USD millions. Note: the LT debt concept is 'LongTermDebtAndCapitalLeaseObligations', so it may include some finance leases.

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 995,000,000 (us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding, 10-K 0001628280-26-019436), in millions
